changes.before: Medium shot at a Thames landing in 1666: one grey-haired middle-aged man with a lined adult face and broad shoulders, in a dark wool doublet and knee breeches, runs from a smoking plain brick house on the left toward a low wooden rowboat moored at the right; his leading boot steps onto its boarding plank and one hand reaches for the boat side, pale cloudy daylight
changes.after: Medium shot at a Thames landing in 1666, one grey-haired adult resident in a plain dark wool doublet and knee breeches climbs into a low wooden rowboat; one boot is inside the hull and both hands grip the near boat side, a smoking plain brick wall behind him, pale cloudy daylight
